capabilities: Create and manage book projects with templates and cover images
Organize chapters in a drag-and-drop tree with status markers
Track word counts, writing progress and goal completion
Export manuscripts to PDF with cover, headers and table of contents
extras: Also includes a Pomodoro focus-writing mode with interruption statistics. PDF preview and export need the desktop (Electron) app; mobile support is untested. Interface is in Simplified Chinese and English.
problem: Long manuscripts spread across notes are hard to structure into chapters, track progress on, and export as one finished book.
summary: Writing-management plugin for book projects, with chapter trees, word-count statistics, reference lists, Pomodoro focus mode and PDF export.
